environment: macOS-26.5.2-arm64-arm-64bit-Mach-O; in-process three-node/multi-group harness with real RawNodes and Raft Engines; manually delivered peer messages, explicit ticks and host-derived election seeds; SIGKILL child fixture; serial integration targets; debug assertions enabled; debuginfo=0; isolated checkout target directory
limitations: MR-03 consensus adapter qualification only. Peer messages use checked-in in-process delivery, not authenticated production transport. The application stub writes real immutable fixture images but does not implement or qualify SQLite/LTX decoding, command execution, query serving, or cryptographic snapshot-image verification. Host workers must provide those image proofs in MR-05/MR-06/MR-10. SDK routing, S3 archival/restore, automatic membership repair, production failure-domain and resident-memory/scale qualification remain required. One ignored child helper is invoked and deliberately killed by its parent test. No production performance or capacity claim is made.

additional_check_results.regressions: 23 passed across native_raft_storage, native_raft_contract, native_replication and native_storage; the storage child helper is deliberately ignored in the parent inventory
additional_check_results.concurrency: Three groups have outstanding proposals before peer delivery, elect distinct leaders, replicate exact entry bytes, and share actual synced engine batches.
additional_check_results.isolation: Other groups commit while one apply and one node-wide disk sync are held.
additional_check_results.lifecycle: Close fences submitted I/O under full admission; domain shutdown joins consensus and engine work; retained handles cannot keep directory locks; engine failure retains its typed cause.
additional_check_results.input_boundaries: Empty ReadIndex requests, exhausted counters, malformed append ranges, invalid snapshots and oversized memberships are rejected before raft-rs.
